# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
----
1. Insert the test records with the correct date to save each time.
---
1. Cover the failed part and the failed reasons.
---
1. If the failed part is only a part, cover the failed part only.
2. If an electrical appliance has no test records, cover it as a new page.
3. Cover the part that fails and its maintenance measures in the Working File.
---
1. End the electrical appliance safety check certificate (new edition) and the working file in the last record folder.
1. Electrical safety check file and cover of electrical appliances file and recording cover
---
---
1. Fill out the test record model and instructions.
---
1. Cover with electrical devices, such as insulation resistance testers, leakage current testers, ground resistance testers, and megger testers.
---
1. Cover the record and read the file.
---
1.
